title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Kominka farmhouse. Keep it, take the alternate, or re-roll. Every option keeps your asks: torii, cherry blossom, a red sun, brush lettering, Japanese text and rich motion.

options.label: Kominka: the farmhouse above the paddies
options.lineage: Thatched farmhouses of Japan's mountain villages: noren, shoji, engawa, andon
options.thesis: Your site is an old farmhouse you walk through, and the valley is always in view.
options.viewport: An indigo noren with your name dyed in white hangs from a cedar beam; three paper lanterns, one per live project, glow beside it; below the hem, the valley: torii, cherry tree, red sun.
options.risk: An interior walk can tip into theme park. Every prop has to carry real content or it goes.

raised.raise: Live state is real: a lantern lights only after your browser reaches that project's URL.
Colour commits at page scale: the noren is a whole field of indigo, never an accent on cream.
One module rules the page: every column and gap snaps to the shoji lattice.
States speak in the house's own signs: a hanging sign when the journal is empty, an empty room when a page is missing.
Total palette commitment: indigo, cedar, paper, vermilion, blossom. Nothing else gets in.
Light is a state: the valley moves from morning to red-sun dusk to lantern-lit night as the visit goes on.

regions.label: indigo noren: name in white, brush kanji
valley: torii, cherry tree, red sun

options.label: Emaki: the valley as one ink scroll
options.lineage: Suibokuga ink-wash handscrolls and the brush title cards of period cinema
options.thesis: One continuous ink-wash valley, painted in code stroke by stroke, with a brush title card for every section.
options.viewport: A giant kanji is brush-written stroke by stroke beside your name; behind it ink ridges, a vermilion torii and a red sun, with petals crossing on the wind.
options.risk: Paper, ink and a red sun is the first picture of Japan anyone, and any AI, reaches for. It only lifts if the brushwork is convincing.

regions.label: ink ridges, torii, red sun, petals

options.label: Anime command wall
options.thesis: Your live products on a wall of orange readouts and kanji-over-caps alarms.
options.viewport: A black wall of framed readouts with a countdown clock taller than the headline.
options.case: Fuses with the live-products story but cannot carry the countryside you asked for without becoming a costume.
options.kept: Live condition readouts on every project.
options.risk: Japanese, but a city control room, not a rural valley.

options.label: Vermilion washi crane
options.lineage: Origami fold diagrams on dyed washi
options.thesis: One sheet of vermilion washi folded, section by section, into a crane.
options.viewport: A red square of paper with fold lines fills the right half; the step list runs down the margin.
options.case: Beautiful material, but torii, blossom and a valley have nowhere to live on a folding sheet.
options.kept: A saturated field that owns whole regions, with visible paper fibre.
options.risk: Reads as a craft tutorial rather than a place.

options.label: Award-grade neubrutalism
options.thesis: Flat clashing solids in heavy black outlines on one strict grid.
options.viewport: A chunky grotesk headline over outlined colour blocks.
options.case: No path to a Japanese countryside without discarding everything that makes it itself.
options.kept: One rhythmic grid that every element locks to.

options.label: Green phosphor terminal
options.thesis: The portfolio as one scrolling green-on-black transcript.
options.viewport: A blinking cursor and an 80-column log of your work.
options.case: The tool a developer operates, worn as a costume, and the opposite of the theme you asked for.
options.kept: States print themselves in the world's own voice instead of generic chrome.

options.label: Data-sublime field
options.thesis: Barcode columns and sine lattices in pure black and white.
options.viewport: A wall of vertical bars with dense numbers in the margin.
options.case: Hiring managers would see noise before they see three live products.
options.kept: Total commitment to a small palette.
options.risk: Striking, cold, and nothing to do with a village.

options.label: Iridescent cloud edge
options.thesis: A white page whose only colour is a thin pastel fringe that shifts with state.
options.viewport: A near-empty white field with a faint mint-to-violet edge.
options.case: Too quiet for the showpiece you asked for.
options.kept: Light as a state that changes while you watch.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean developer portfolio in the current standard, executed well.
canonCard.viewport: Name, role and two buttons over a dark ground, with a row of project cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from most developer portfolios by design, and it drops the Japanese countryside.
